scoring.notes: Simulation only — no real patient, no real record, no diagnosis.
scoring.pass: All steps in order, every check passed. Practice score only — it certifies nothing.

steps.action: Greet the practice visitor and explain the three check-in steps.
steps.check: All three steps explained before anything is entered.
steps.if_wrong: Nobody is checked in without knowing the steps. Explain first.

steps.action: Enter the practice details at the kiosk: name, reason for visit.
steps.check: Details entered; nothing real entered — practice data only.
steps.if_wrong: Real details never go into a practice kiosk. Use practice data.

steps.action: Take consent: explain what the details are for, and get a yes.
steps.check: Consent asked and given before the record is kept.
steps.if_wrong: No consent, no record. Ask again.

steps.action: Point the visitor to the right zone and log the check-in.
steps.check: Direction given; check-in logged as practice.
steps.if_wrong: An unlogged check-in did not happen. Log it.

simulations.title: Kiosk Check-In Run

simulations.label: SIMULATION — practice only. Not a licence, not a certification, not a credential, not a diagnosis, not advice for any real person, site or deal.
simulations.scenario: Tour the imaging room, run a practice scan, and find the labelled feature on the lightbox.

scoring.notes: Practice images only. Nothing here is a real scan or a real finding.
scoring.pass: All steps in order, every check passed. Practice score only — it certifies nothing.

steps.action: Apron on before the scan: lead apron from the rack, fitted and checked.
steps.check: Apron on and fitted before approaching the table.
steps.if_wrong: No apron, no scan. Restart the step.

steps.action: Run the practice scan from the console, following the on-screen steps.
steps.check: Scan run in order; no step skipped.
steps.if_wrong: A skipped step is a failed scan. Run it again.

steps.action: At the lightbox, find the labelled feature in the practice image.
steps.if_wrong: Look again — the feature is labelled. Name what it is.

steps.action: Say what the feature is not: one thing it is not, and why.
steps.check: One exclusion stated with a reason.
steps.if_wrong: Knowing what it is not is half the skill. State it.

Fabric: 30 nodes total (scene root + 18 top-level + nested Agent/Swarm children); 12 distinct GLB refs, all unhosted — see missing_models.

Districts/buildings = the real 'Zone · ...' nodes. NPCs = the real 'Agent · ...' nodes (nested under their zones; NPC position = zone position + the agent node's local offset) plus all three real 'Advisor · ...' nodes (Host Advisor, Steward Liaison, Alignment Advisor; top-level fabric positions through the world transform). The 'Steward seat 1–3 · human' nodes are human seats, not game characters, and are not NPCs. All NPC dialogue is original game dialogue, never attributed to a real person.
Biome 'campus' is a design choice for this interpretation.
Agent companions are game characters representing the real Virtuals agents (agents.json); their live instances are offline — not live connections.
Zones (5): Medical Kiosk, 4D Imaging Room, Virtual Molecular Lab, Metaverse Medical Office, Steward Council.
Screening-support framing only: nothing in this world diagnoses, and no NPC claims to be a clinician.
